items.title: Home Depot Stocks Fall 2.21% Despite Beat as CFO McPhail Named CEO
items.summary: Third-quarter sales rose 4.9% to $43.4 billion, but the full-year comparable sales outlook sits near 1.4% and margins slipped.

items.title: Disney earnings show consumers will still pay up for experiences
items.summary: Siebert Financial chief investment officer Mark Malek and his panel of experts weigh in on how resilient the US consumer looks heading into the holidays, with Disney (DIS) reporting a strong fourth quarter and premium experiential spending, like Viking Cruises (VIK), holding up. Today's panel includes Yahoo Finance's Julie Hyman, Solidarity Wealth CEO Jeff McClean, Roundhill Investments ETF strategist Thomas DiFazio, and Alumni Ventures managing partner Laura Rippy.
